en.headline: Over 34,000 subdivided units registered under simplified-flats scheme
en.dek: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said about 70 per cent of Hong Kong’s estimated 110,000 subdivided units need only minor works to meet minimum standards, and registration progress is satisfactory.
body: More than 34,000 subdivided units have been registered under the simplified-flats scheme since it opened on 1 March, Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said on Monday, describing the progress as ideal.

Speaking after a sharing session at Housing Authority headquarters attended by more than 100 professionals, agents, property managers and owners, Ho noted that Hong Kong has about 110,000 subdivided units. Rough estimates suggest about 70 per cent, or roughly 80,000 units, require only small-scale modifications to meet the minimum standards and are expected to form the main future supply of simplified flats. The registrations so far account for more than 40 per cent of those 80,000 units.

Owners who have not yet registered were urged to do so as soon as possible to secure a three-year grace period for works. Those who register by 31 August will also be exempted from the HK$3,000 certification application fee for each unit provided certification is completed by 28 February 2029.

zh.headline: 逾3.4萬分間單位已交簡樸房登記申請 何永賢稱進度理想
zh.dek: 房屋局局長指全港約11萬個分間單位中，約七成只需小規模改動即可符合最低標準，鼓勵業主在8月31日前登記。
body: 簡樸房登記制度於今年3月1日展開，房屋局局長何永賢周一表示，截至當日已有涉及超過3.4萬個分間單位遞交登記申請，形容進度理想。
何永賢在房屋委員會總部舉行的「簡樸房制度推展經驗分享會」後於社交平台指出，香港現存約11萬個分間單位，粗略估計約七成、即約8萬個只需小規模改動便可符合簡樸房最低標準，相信會是未來簡樸房的主要供應。已遞交申請的單位粗略佔上述8萬個的逾四成。
她鼓勵未登記的分間單位業主盡早登記，以取得三年寬限期執整單位。在今年8月31日或之前登記者，只要於2029年2月28日或之前完成認證，每個簡樸房均可獲豁免3,000元認證申請費。
